what: THE RATCHET FOR TEXT NOBODY CAN READ, frozen 9/5/26 on build 9/5ak.
how: The eyes gate opens both surfaces at 390x844, taps the splash, waits for the game, and measures the WCAG contrast of every on-glass text box in the finished picture (the DOM says where the words are, the picture says what they look like, because a scrim drawn over the text is invisible to the styles). THE INK AND THE PAPER ARE FOUND BY SPLITTING EACH BOX AT THE MIDPOINT OF ITS OWN RANGE, not by taking the darkest and lightest tenths -- see why_it_moved below.
state: The morning card is UP, because that is the screen a player lands on and because it is the only state this harness can reach deterministically. Measured twice, same number both times.
the_rule: This number may never go UP. It is a population baseline, the pixel-craft and style-card precedent: the 38 that exist are history, and the gate exists so a 39th cannot be added quietly. When a lane fixes some, lower this number by hand in the same commit.

worst_today.note: 0 of 24 under the floor with both cards answered, measured 9/6

with_the_card_dismissed: 7 of 13 text boxes are still under the floor: the status line 1.75, OUTFIT 1.80, WHOLE MAP 2.82, BIKE 3.46, CITY 3.67, SLEEP 3.70, STANDING 4.22. So the card is not the whole story; the chips are dim on their own.
why_it_moved: LOWERED 38 -> 27 on 9/6 by UI lane 11, row [eyes: faint chips], and MOST OF THE DROP IS A BROKEN RULER RATHER THAN A FIX. The old method took the darkest tenth of a box against the lightest tenth, and a tenth is only 'the ink' if the ink really is a tenth of the box. The MUSIC chip is 10px text inside a 44px thumb: the letters are TWO PER CENT of its pixels, so the top tenth was still background and it scored 1.21:1 for a label anybody can read. The letters are 6.17:1. OUTFIT 1.21 against 5.77. PHONE, dark text on gold, is the same error inverted: 3.24 against 6.29. AND IT FAILED THE OTHER WAY TOO: the eight walk-pad arrows, the one control that makes the game advance, scored 4.9-5.1 and PASSED while the letters were 4.31-4.46 and did not clear the floor. WORST OF ALL IT PUNISHED THE FIX -- a bigger tap target means letters are a smaller share of the box, so the 44px thumb this lane shipped the same day made every score WORSE. Two real failures were fixed in the same commit (the walk arrows and the ambient caption), and gates/readable_ruler_gate.py now proves the ruler still bites: two synthetic boxes nobody could read must fail and two anybody can read must pass, at the same 2% ink fraction that broke the old method.
still_in_the_27: Almost all of what is left is text UNDER THE MORNING CARD'S SCRIM, which this harness holds up because it is the screen a player lands on and the only state it can reach deterministically. A modal dimming what is behind it is intended, not a craft defect. FOR EYES: the number worth ratcheting may be the one with the cards answered, where it is now ZERO -- tools/bohemia_readable_on_the_played_screen.js measures that state. That is a call for the lane that owns this harness, not a change this lane made to it.
